tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List builder projects for the org (paginated, filterable).

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project for one of the org's clients (by email).

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get a single project by id.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update a project's name, description, or status.

tools.name: get_preview_urls
tools.description: Get published/preview URLs for a project.

tools.name: create_client
tools.description: Create a client (end-customer) for the org.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Aggregated analytics for the org (optionally one project).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_preview_urls · Public sink: create_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_preview_urls · Public sink: create_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
